title: Daniel Mentz on National Status, Passports, and the Right to Travel
description:
This month’s Free Traveler Monthly #CONFAB featured a wide-ranging discussion on the Right to Travel, public versus private activity, nationality, jurisdiction, and the expanding administrative systems that govern modern life.

Special guest Daniel Mentz of the Sacred Honor Educational Fellowship joined us to discuss the historical and legal foundations of National Status and the practical implications surrounding passports, jurisdiction, and political status.
